title: Atlantis as a multi-site Ice Age civilization
place_text: North America, Azores, Sahara, Amazon, submerged continental shelves

tellings.quote: but I think it was more than one place.

plain: Atlantis, the lost civilization of legend, is said to have been not one island but a spread of Ice Age settlements, in North America, the Azores, the Sahara, the Amazon and on coastlines now under the sea. The writer Graham Hancock offers this as his own view on the show, saying "I think it was more than one place," and he mentions the researchers Randall Carlson and Jimmy Corsetti. If true, a whole advanced culture would have been lost when the ice melted and seas rose.
